text:
alex_support: Customer reported promo code not applying for EU customer paying in GBP. They see discount at checkout but billing shows promo: false on the invoice. Need quick triage.
priya_billing: can you paste the invoice id / backend payload? also which promo code and eligibility rule?
alex_support: promo: FREE50EU, invoice id: inv_2026_07_1827
alex_support: ```json\n{\n  \"invoice_id\": \"inv_2026_07_1827\",\n  \"currency\": \"GBP\",\n  \"line_items\": [{\"desc\": \"Usage\", \"pre_tax_amount\": 42.00, \"tax_amount\": 8.40, \"gross_amount\": 50.40}],\n  \"promo_applied\": false,\n  \"promo_eval\": {\"code\": \"FREE50EU\", \"min_pre_tax_usd\": 50.00, \"eval_amount_usd\": 53.20} \n}\n```
theo_engineer: quick read: billing is converting pre-tax GBP -> USD for threshold, but promo-validation path is using gross_amount when locale is VAT-inclusive. rounding pushes eval over threshold inconsistently. looks like an edge-case for inclusive VAT locales.
jules_product: is this reproducible? does it only affect EU VAT-inclusive countries or any locale with tax included in displayed subtotal?
theo_engineer: repro steps: 1) create invoice with pre_tax 42 GBP, tax 8.4 (20%), 2) promo threshold in USD 50, conversion rate used by promo service returns 1.26 -> pre_tax_usd = 52.92, gross_usd = 63.50, but our promo check sometimes reads gross due to legacy flag for inclusive-tax locales. failing path: uses gross_usd instead of pre_tax_usd and then applies rounding floor -> false negative.
alex_support: customer screenshot attached (they're on support thread) — asked if we can grant trial credits while we fix.
priya_billing: we can grant one-off credit. finance needs GL code and ticket. I'll create chargeback and note tax treatment. assign to billing-ops.
priya_billing: manual credit command (internal): `POST /internal/credits { "account_id": "acct_3401", "amount": 50, "currency": "USD", "reason": "promo-misapply-vat-edge" }` :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: [auto] created billing ticket TKT-4927 for inv_2026_07_1827 assigned to billing-ops
theo_engineer: I'll open PR to use pre_tax_amount for promo threshold checks and add an integration test for VAT-inclusive locales. branch: fix/promo-vat-eval
jules_product: please add an alert if promo_eval_count_failures spikes > 5/hr for EU locales. Also update promo docs to specify pre-tax evaluation for clarity.
priya_billing: finance ticket TKT-4927 created, estimated resolution/credit processed in 1 biz day. posting GL code: 4-102-REB.
alex_support: customer agreed to manual credit, sending confirmation now :thumbsup:
theo_engineer: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/inference/+/12345 — ETA review 24h.
jules_product: thanks team. make sure QA covers rounding boundaries and currency conversion quirks. once PR merges, let's run a regen job to re-eval pending invoices for last 30 days.
alex_support: will follow up with customer after credit posts and close ticket. marking internal follow-ups. :pray:
